ci_and_platform_findings.remote_cache: Fresh PR #1542 cloud-ci run 30878231349 again reported Buck2 Cache hits: 0%, remote: 0 and Network Up: 0B. NativeLink remote cache/RE are not active; #1534 remains open and this must not be inferred from deployment inventory.
ci_and_platform_findings.windows: A real Windows kernel needs a native Windows VM/host cell. Current arm64 Talos/HVF workers have no hardware-accelerated nested virtualization; do not substitute a Linux container, Wine, or software emulation.
